feature_contract.goal: Make real D3D9 SM3 partial-TEMP and swizzled shader sequences eligible for native D3D11 bytecode/object creation without reading unwritten lanes or bypassing D3D9 fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Interpret MOV/MAD/CMP/scalar/dot/cross/texture/matrix source-register masks in production VS/PS translator; admit only lanes actually consumed and preserve translated native shader compilation.
Reject genuinely unwritten swizzled TEMP lanes, invalid source operands, unknown shader ops and unsupported matrix/texture variants; retain original D3D9 rendering/input/FFB.
All five mandatory GitHub Actions succeed at one non-skipped material result SHA, without inferring actual menu-car-race or Quest3 parity.

integration_path: D3D11 SM3 shader bytecode HLSL arithmetic/temp register source materialization
Native Draw/DrawIndexed shader binding and D3D9 fallback
development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Game native draw/published frames and menu-car-race visual parity require matching real-game test; currently UNTESTED.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native opt-in and original D3D9/DX9Ex render/input/FFB remain; unknown/unwritten shader lanes fail closed; DXVK frozen.

pipeline.C0_RECOVER: 00929 exact-SHA build verified; latest source baseline 14a9a140; 00930 unclaimed at start.
pipeline.C1_REVIEW: SM3 translator incorrectly required all four swizzled TEMP lanes even when an opcode/destination mask consumed fewer.
pipeline.C2_IMPLEMENT: Patch production SM3 bytecode-to-HLSL source reads by opcode, destination mask and swizzle, including dot/matrix/TEX scalar exceptions; preserve rejects for unwritten channels.
pipeline.C3_VALIDATE: Mandatory exact SHA Actions Fast/Backend/Win32/OpenXR/HUD all 5 success. Game/HMD remains UNTESTED.

REAL_GAME_DRAW_BLOCKER: Game programmable shader register eligibility improved in source; positive real-game native draw and published native frame remain UNTESTED.
NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION_ACTION: Test a matching real game menu-car-race executable with native opt-in and inspect eligible_state_draws, native_draws, native published frames; continue remaining shader/resource connection without claiming gameplay parity.
score_policy: Only one independent actual material contribution may earn score; C6/retry/rollover/CI repeat +0.
